title: Move Your Feet
style: world big band jazz, female lead vocal, brass kora and live drums, 96 BPM, call and response, multilingual pickleball coaching anthem, uplifting choir, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[INTRO]
(spoken)
Bad shots happen for one reason.
Feet stopped moving.
In every language, same lesson.

[VERSE 1 - English]
Move your feet before you swing
Footwork is the first thing
Split step when the ball is struck
Ready position, never stuck

[VERSE 2 - Faroese transliteration]
Flet fotini adur tu svingir
Fotararbeidid er tad fyrsta
Kloyv skrigva ta ballurinn er sligni
Ella stellingur, aldri fastur

[VERSE 3 - Odia transliteration]
Swing kariba agu paa chalao
Footwork e pratham katha
Bola mara helei split step karo
Ready position, kabhi atka nahi

[CHORUS]
MOVE - FLET - CHALAO - HARAKAT
FEET FIRST - SPLIT STEP - HOLD YOUR LINE
MOVE YOUR FEET - EVERY SHOT
FOOTWORK WINS - EVERY TIME

[VERSE 4 - Uzbek transliteration]
Urushdan oldin oyoqlaringizni harakatlantiring
Oyoq ishi birinchi narsa
Top urilganda bolinib turing
Tayyor holat, hech qachon qotib qolmang

[VERSE 5 - Xhosa transliteration]
Hambisa iinyawo zakho ngaphambi kokudubula
Ukusebenza kweenyawo kukuqala
Shukuma xa ibhola ibetha
Isikhundla esilungileyo, ungaze umisel

[VERSE 6 - Latvian]
Pakustini kajas pirms sitiena
Kajas darbs ir pirmais
Dalits solis kad bumba tiek sista
Gatava pozicija, nekad nekustigi

[CHORUS]
MOVE - FLET - CHALAO - HARAKAT
FEET FIRST - SPLIT STEP - HOLD YOUR LINE
MOVE YOUR FEET - EVERY SHOT
FOOTWORK WINS - EVERY TIME

[BRIDGE - spoken]
(coach voice)
Faroese. Odia. Uzbek. Xhosa. Latvian.
Feet. First. Always.
Split step. Every shot.
Move your feet.

[FINAL CHORUS]
MOVE - FLET - CHALAO - HARAKAT
FEET FIRST - SPLIT STEP - HOLD YOUR LINE
MOVE YOUR FEET - EVERY SHOT
FOOTWORK WINS - EVERY TIME
EVERY LANGUAGE - ONE TRUTH
MOVE YOUR FEET - EVERY TIME

[OUTRO]
Every language. Every court.
Move your feet.
